scope: Only the two requested NORD2 daemon hold/release paths, their original linked constants, and virtual slot/callback targets. No full-kernel/source/ISA audit repeated.

checks.claim: StartIOKitMatching retains platform matching and stop hook, samples time/root busy, logs held0, and does not take daemon hold.
Genuine daemon-ready path preserves availability guard and panic branch, conditional trace, deferred-match list extraction/iteration/release, and IOKit user resource publication.

Paired NORD2 branches present together; neither body calls adjustBusy. Actual IOService vtable distinguishes getBusyState1624 from adjustBusy1632. Other indirect targets are preserved deferred-array and resource callbacks. No unmatched daemon decrement, arbitrary quiet reset, or synthetic daemon activation introduced.

Both log strings are verified at actual ADRP+ADD-referenced addresses; retained resource publication globals/virtual targets and deferred block target verified from original Mach-O bytes. Details in artifact/supplement.json.

limits: Static linked semantics only, not device execution or Settings scan delivery.
No proof of historical daemon hold identity, continuous registry quiet, or cause/remedy of the Settings delay.
Root owns separate full CI source equality/generic flags/ISA audits; those are not inferred here.
Non-NORD2 branches are not selected in this actual kernel; their source/preprocessor tests are in prior private proposal.
